Playbook.name: PAN-OS — Sensitive Firewall Change (Security Rule or Admin User) - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: A PAN-OS change touched a SENSITIVE object - a security rule (rulebase/security/rules) or an administrator account (mgt-config/admin) - via set/delete/edit/rename. Triage question: is this an authorised security-policy/admin change, or tampering that weakens protection or plants a backdoor admin?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Security-rule and admin-account changes directly control what the firewall permits and who can manage it - the highest-impact config changes.

Assets.AssetType: Internal and DMZ hosts behind PAN-OS

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: PAN-OS logs via Elastic Agent to logs-panw.panos-* (verified live).

Fields: panw.panos.sub_type (vulnerability/spyware/CONFIG/...), panw.panos.action (alert/allow/reset-both/drop), event.severity (numeric; lower = more severe, 5 = informational), panw.panos.threat_category, panw.panos.threat.name, panw.panos.admin, panw.panos.cmd, panw.panos.path, panw.panos.result, source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port, network.application.

Signal.Name: Sensitive config change
Signal.Details: CONFIG, cmd set/delete/edit/rename, path rulebase*security*rules or admin.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Security-rule and admin changes must map to a change ticket; a new admin account or a rule permitting broad access is a backdoor shape.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the sensitive change is authorised policy/admin work or tampering (weakening a rule, adding a backdoor admin).

Step.name: Detail the sensitive change - object, command, result
Step.Purpose: See exactly which security rule or admin object was changed and how.
Step.Query: FROM logs-panw.panos-* | WHERE panw.panos.type == "CONFIG" AND panw.panos.cmd IN ("set","delete","edit","rename") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS changes = COUNT(*), paths = VALUES(panw.panos.path), cmds = VALUES(panw.panos.cmd), results = VALUES(panw.panos.result) BY panw.panos.admin | SORT changes DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: A 'set' on mgt-config/admin = new/modified admin account (possible backdoor). A 'delete' on a security rule = protection removed. An 'edit' widening a rule's source/destination = exposure. Read the path carefully.

Step.name: Broader change session by this admin
Step.Purpose: Sensitive changes bundled with many others, or by an unfamiliar admin, indicate tampering vs a single approved edit.
Step.Query: FROM logs-panw.panos-* | WHERE panw.panos.type == "CONFIG" AND panw.panos.admin == "$admin" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS total_changes = COUNT(*), all_paths = VALUES(panw.panos.path), all_cmds = VALUES(panw.panos.cmd), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: A large change session touching rules AND admins AND logging config in minutes is a tampering pattern. A single scoped rule edit is normal administration.

Node.Condition: INV-01 shows a new admin account created (set on mgt-config/admin) or a security rule deleted/widened with no change ticket.
Node.Result: True Positive (Firewall Tampering / Backdoor Admin - IR immediately)

Node.Condition: INV-02 shows a large multi-object change session by an unfamiliar admin.
INV-01 shows a scoped security-rule change by a recognised admin matching an approved ticket.
Sensitive change by a plausible admin but no ticket located.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-PANSENS-CHANGE, INV-02-PANSENS-SESSION to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: Authorised security-policy or admin-account administration under change control.

SOCAction.Item: Verify the change ticket and object diff; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: Tampering that weakens protection or plants a backdoor administrator.

Indicators.Item: Unfamiliar admin or large tampering session.

SOCAction.Item: Revert the change; disable any rogue admin account; open IR.
Audit all recent security-rule and admin changes; check for exposure created.

Misconfiguration.Definition: Automation making sensitive changes too broadly due to misconfiguration.

Indicators.Item: An automation admin per a broken template.

SOCAction.Item: Correct the automation; revert erroneous changes; document.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Review the sensitive object change; revert if unauthorised.
Disable any rogue admin account now.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Audit all recent security-rule/admin changes; check for exposure; reset compromised admins.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce approval for security-rule and admin changes; PAM for firewall admins; config backup/diff.

QualityChecks.Check: Path filter targets rulebase/security/rules and admin objects; cmd set/delete/edit/rename verified present.
This is the high-impact subset of PB-PAN-003; a new admin account is the clearest backdoor signal.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Tampering reverted; rogue admin removed; exposure closed; changes audited.
